_source: NextGen E-Sports is a prototype club and this schedule is fictional. Venue coordinates are a real Kuala Lumpur location so the live forecast returns meaningful data.

events.title: Valorant Scrim Night
events.description: Casual scrim night for anyone who wants reps in. Mixed skill levels, drop in and grab a lobby.

events.title: Aim & Crosshair Placement Workshop
events.description: Open to all members. Fundamentals of crosshair placement, counter-strafing and routine building.

events.title: BLAST Premier World Final — Watch Party
events.description: Big-screen watch party for the BLAST Premier World Final. Snacks provided, open to guests.

events.title: Open Roster Tryouts
events.description: Open tryouts across Valorant, Counter-Strike and PUBG. Registration required — bring your own peripherals.

events.title: PUBG Squad Practice
events.description: Casual squad practice — rotations, zone reading and comms. Drop-in, no squad required in advance.

events.title: Members LAN Social
events.description: Casual LAN night. Mixed lobbies, no rank requirements, new members strongly encouraged.

events.title: VCT Ignition Series — Watch Party
events.description: Big-screen watch party for the VCT Ignition Series playoffs. Open to guests, no membership required.

events.title: VOD Review Masterclass
events.description: How to review your own demos: timestamping mistakes, tracking utility usage, building an improvement log.

_note: Fictional club schedule. Weather is fetched live from Open-Meteo with jQuery. See CLAUDE.md sections 2 and 6.
